visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in an indoor athletic training room with light wood paneled walls and blue foam mats. A muscular man in a white tank top and grey shorts lifts a large black weight plate by its rim with his fingers. Behind him, several young athletes in matching green and yellow camouflage jerseys with different numbers watch attentively. (2) The scene cuts rapidly between different athletes attempting the same lift with a black weight plate labeled with a white '5KG' text overlay. They use a pinch grip on the edge of the circular plate, holding it with both hands. The background features sports equipment, fans, and a whiteboard with handwritten schedules in Japanese characters. (3) The challenge weight increases, marked by text overlays of '10KG' and '15KG'. The athletes take turns attempting the lift; their facial expressions show increasing strain, with squinted eyes and tight mouth lines. Their hand tension is visible as they struggle to maintain the pinch grip on the thicker plates. (4) At the '20KG' mark, the physical effort becomes significantly more intense. One athlete in jersey number 10 visibly struggles, and a teammate in jersey number 8 reaches out to help stabilize the plate. They are smiling and laughing, indicating a supportive and lighthearted training atmosphere despite the high physical demand. (5) The final phase shows the '25KG' challenge. The man in the white tank top performs a successful lift. Multiple athletes then try the same weight; one athlete loses his grip, causing the heavy plate to fall and bounce on the blue mats. The group reacts with large smiles, loud laughter, and animated body language.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy electronic dance music track featuring a sharp, driving percussion beat and a dark synth bassline. No speech is present, but short grunts of effort from male voices are heard. (2) Each visual cut is punctuated by the rhythmic bass drum of the BGM. Occasional faint chatter and background murmurs of other people in the room are heard but remain below the music level. (3) As the difficulty increases, the audio captures distinct exclamations of effort. The music maintains a constant high-tempo energy, creating a sense of momentum. (4) Vocal arousal peaks as the 20KG weight is lifted; a collective burst of male laughter and short cheers break through the mix. The pitch variability of the voices indicates positive excitement and camaraderie. (5) A resonant, percussive thud is clearly heard as a 25KG weight plate hits the mat. This is immediately followed by a chorus of loud, high-valence laughter and energetic vocalizations from the team, ending with the music.
